description: Tell it the product and the packaging, and get a finished packaging design in the member's Creadal account: a professionally laid-out ready design for that model with the brand, product name and label facts filled in, a preview picture, the 3D look, a print PDF link and a link to open it in the Creadal editor. Optionally makes a product photo with AI for the label (that uses one AI image from the member's plan). Pick the model with list_packaging_models (id or slug).

description.description: What the product is, in a sentence: helps pick the best ready design.

language.description: Language of the names and label texts: en (default), tr or ar.

manufacturer.description: Maker or distributor name and address.

model.description: The packaging model's id or slug, e.g. 'pouch-stand-up' or 'tuck-end-box'.

net_quantity.description: Net weight or volume, e.g. '250 g' or '500 ml'.

product_name.description: The product's name as it should read on the pack.

product_photo.description: Optional: describe a product photo to make with AI for the label (uses one AI image from the plan).

ready_design.description: Optional: a ready design id to start from instead of the best match.

tagline.description: A short line under the name.

name: create_packaging_design
title: Design packaging
